asr.full_text: hello everybody thanks for watching this video this video is on the second step which is opening an exchange account I the second step comes after the first step which was signing with bitlab network and it was covered on the previous video. So the exchange account will enable you to change your fiat currency to digital currency for you. Your fiat being rain in South Africa. to digital being bitcoins. So this video is for you if you're a beginner with Bit Club Network. You have already signed up and you want to take the next steps, which would be paying for your membership and buying a pool. In South Africa there are three types of exchange accounts that you could use. There is luno.com, alcantrader.com, and local bitcoin.com please note that this will vary from country to country i have a list of different exchange accounts that could be used for different countries but for South Africa we have these three and because this is an example of how we've used our old ones in a different way than the new ones. For example, for South Africa you have 3 different exchange accounts that could be used for different countries, but for South Africa we have these three. And for this presentation I will use LUNO to demonstrate because LUNO is simple and easy to use the exchange accounts like LocalBitcoins.com. Alcon Trader is an exception because as much as it's cheaper to pay through Alcon Trader but it is a bit more complicated, you know to use. So, in opening the exchange accounts we will go through three steps. The first step, I will demonstrate how to sign up with Luno, and then the second will be the money, the third will be making the payment to BitClub Network. So I will flip the screen and dive straight into it to sign up with luna on the browser you will type papa.luna.com. and it will take you to this page where you click sign up and then enter your details, your email address, your password, you should make sure that your password has 8 characters, and... which contain numbers, lower case and upper case... letters, and then you choose the country here you confirm that you're not a robot then you sign up. after signing up, as with all sign-ups in need to do an email verification so this is how you email to like and then you will confirm your email.that would be Level 0 verification in Luno. there are 2 more verifications that you will need to do. And the levels will give access to varied withdrawal and deposit limits. So, for the 1st level, which has a limit of $15,000 deposits and withdrawals, we'll need you to confirm your phone number and your basic personal details. This is how the page would look like after confirming your email and then the first thing that you will receive here is a message to confirm your mobile and other personal details. Then Level 2 you will need to submit your ID and that will give you access to 50,000 in Deposits and Withdrawals. Level 3 you will need to submit your Proof of Physical Attr physical address and that will give you a higher limit. and in some countries like Indonesia, there will be no limit, so it will depend on the country. It is key for you to do all the levels particularly if you are planning to buy pool 2 upwards. because those pools will cost more than $15,000. Once you are done with the verifications you will need to deposit money into Loonor. There are 2 ways of doing it. On the home page, you will click the tab more which will take you to Deposit Money and it will take you to that page. The other way of doing it, on the left click the tab Wallet, and select Za Wallet, click And your will select Zha wallet Click deposit And it will take you to the same page So With the information here, basically Luno is asking you to select the bank which you will be transferring from So if you bank with FNB click here. If it's with standard bank click here or if it's another bank you click here. But since I bank with FNB, I click here and then you put the amount that you want to transfer, the amount that you want to deposit which is $15,000 you need to make that to put enough money to pay for membership by pull and also accommodate for the transactional charges, click here when you click in it will take you here and these are Lununo's banking details with FNB, so this is their bank FNB, their name this is their account number. You enter all these details on the EFT that you will be doing with your bank, so this will be the beneficiary details that you will put when doing the AFT and what is key here is this reference. You put this reference and once you have transferred the money from your bank you will need to come back to luno and confirm that you have done the deposit so once money is cleared in luno it will show somewhere here or when you click world it will show on the Zahar wallet but it will reflect once it's deposited once it's clear so what you will need to do here to exchange the currency you all simply click here on Bitcoin wallet to exchange user to Bitcoin so that you're able to buy a pool and pay the membership so you click, but because there's nothing in my Zawa Let This is what it will show me. Once again Thank-you for watching this video Don't forget subscribe to my channel, and like this video, if you need assistance, Send me an Email and you can also follow me on Instagram at just tsundere. I use the same name on Facebook. I will put all my contact details at the bottom of this video.
